tldr: 台股週三續崩，再跌 1,564.18 點、跌幅 3.76%，收 40,039.18 點，勉強守住 4 萬關卡，115 檔跌停；兩日累計重挫約 8%。
外資續砍、單日賣超 222.52 億元，三大法人合計賣超 317.57 億元；台積電跌 3.51% 至 2,200 元，外資連 6 賣。
大摩喊話「別被過去週期嚇跑」，維持記憶體股買進評等，指 HBM 帶動的缺貨恐惡化至 2028 年，半導體熊市中逢低仍具價值。
金管會核准 7 家國銀自 2026 第 4 季採用內部評等法（IRB），預估平均資本適足率提升約 0.34 個百分點，放款與配息空間同步擴大。

items.title_zh: 台股再崩 1,564 點，勉守 4 萬關
items.title_en: TAIEX sinks another 1,564 points, clinging to the 40,000 line
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週三終場收 40,039.18 點，重挫 1,564.18 點、跌幅 3.76%，延續前一日史上級跌勢，兩日跌幅逾 8%。盤面劇烈震盪，高低差達 2,313.54 點，上市櫃下跌家數多達 1,619 家、跌停 115 檔。槓桿去化與 AI 評價疑慮持續壓盤，成交量續放大，4 萬點整數關卡岌岌可危，短線波動料仍偏高，投資人宜嚴控風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark tumbled a further 1,564.18 points, or 3.76%, on Wednesday to close at 40,039.18, extending a brutal two-session slide after Tuesday's record-scale drop. The tape was violent: an intraday swing of 2,313.54 points, 1,619 decliners across the listed boards and 115 stocks locked limit-down. Turnover stayed heavy as forced deleveraging and AI-valuation fears fed the selling, leaving the psychologically key 40,000 level barely intact and traders braced for further volatility.

items.title_zh: 外資賣超 222 億，台積電挫至 2,200 元、外資連 6 賣
items.title_en: Foreign funds dump NT$22bn, TSMC slides to NT$2,200 on sixth day of outflows
items.summary_zh: 週三三大法人合計賣超 317.57 億元，其中外資賣超 222.52 億元、自營商賣超 185.99 億元，投信則買超 90.94 億元。權王台積電下跌 3.51%、收 2,200 元，外資連續第 6 個交易日調節、單日賣超 11,211 張，投信與自營商小幅承接。法人持續撤離凸顯市場情緒由貪婪快速轉為恐懼，AI 權值股承壓，資金動向仍是後市關鍵觀察指標。
items.summary_en: Overseas investors sold a net NT$22.25bn on Wednesday while the three major institutions offloaded NT$31.76bn (foreigners −NT$22.25bn, dealers −NT$18.60bn, but investment trusts bought NT$9.09bn). Bellwether TSMC fell 3.51% to NT$2,200 as foreign investors sold it for a sixth consecutive session, unloading 11,211 lots, even as trusts and dealers nibbled. The relentless institutional exit underscored how quickly sentiment has flipped from greed to fear across the AI-heavy index.

items.title_zh: 大摩挺記憶體：缺貨恐惡化至 2028 年
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley stays bullish on memory: shortage seen worsening to 2028
items.summary_zh: 在半導體陷入熊市式回檔之際，大摩喊話投資人「別被過去週期嚇跑」，維持記憶體類股買進評等。摩根士丹利認為，AI 需求（尤以高頻寬記憶體 HBM 為首）正結構性收緊供給，缺貨情況預估將延續惡化至 2027、2028 年，並指美光帶頭的反彈「只是開始」，暗示此波賣壓屬評價重設而非多頭循環結束，記憶體族群中長線題材未變。
items.summary_en: With semiconductors mired in a bear-market swoon, Morgan Stanley urged investors "not to be scared off by past cycles," reiterating a buy stance on memory makers. The broker argues that AI-driven demand, led by high-bandwidth memory (HBM), is structurally tightening supply, with shortages projected to worsen through 2027 and 2028. It framed the recent Micron-led rebound as merely the beginning, suggesting the current sell-off is a valuation reset rather than an end to the up-cycle.

items.title_zh: AI 供應鏈迎關鍵法說週
items.title_en: AI supply chain enters a make-or-break earnings week
items.summary_zh: 台灣 AI 硬體族群進入關鍵時點，多場法人說明會與記憶體報價更新同步登場。市場聚焦先進封裝（CoWoS）擴產進度、晶圓代工稼動率與第三季展望；輝達新一代 Rubin 平台推動供應鏈從單純 GPU 出貨，升級至機櫃級「系統整合」新階段。法說與報價訊號交會，預料將主導近期晶片與伺服器類股走向，而這些正是牽動大盤劇烈震盪的核心族群，後續指引值得緊盯。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's AI hardware complex is heading into a pivotal stretch as a cluster of investor conferences and memory-pricing updates land together. Attention centres on advanced-packaging (CoWoS) capacity, foundry utilisation and third-quarter guidance, with Nvidia's next-generation Rubin platform pushing suppliers toward rack-level "system integration" rather than bare GPU shipments. The confluence of earnings and pricing signals is expected to set the near-term tone for chip and server names that have driven the index's swings.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准 7 銀行第 4 季採 IRB 計提資本
items.title_en: FSC clears seven banks to adopt IRB capital approach from Q4
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准中信、北富銀、國泰世華、合庫、兆豐、第一與玉山等 7 家國銀，自 2026 年第 4 季起採用信用風險「內部評等法」（IRB）計提資本。全案歷經初審、複審、實地審查及 1 年試辦，就風險管理架構、模型驗證與資料品質全面把關。金管會採 5 年過渡安排，首季適用 95% 產出下限，逐年調降至 2031 年第 4 季的 72.5%，資本釋放採漸進方式上路，兼顧穩健與競爭力。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission approved seven domestic banks — CTBC, Taipei Fubon, Cathay United, Taiwan Cooperative, Mega, First and E.Sun — to use the internal-ratings-based (IRB) approach for credit-risk capital, effective from the fourth quarter of 2026. Approval followed initial and secondary reviews, on-site checks and a one-year trial. A five-year transition applies a 95% output floor from Q4, stepping down to a final 72.5% by Q4 2031, phasing in the capital relief gradually.

items.title_zh: IRB 過關，放款與配息空間變大
items.title_en: IRB green light widens room for lending and dividends
items.summary_zh: 內部評等法上路預估可使 7 家銀行平均資本適足率（BIS）提升約 0.34 個百分點，釋放的資本可投入新增放款或回饋股東。分析認為此舉將強化國銀國際競爭力與風險管理水準，市場也點名配息空間擴大為短線利多。由於採分階段產出下限，效益將逐年顯現而非一次到位，但整體資本體質朝正向增厚，對這批銀行的中長期營運與股利政策具實質支撐。
items.summary_en: The IRB approval is expected to lift the seven banks' average capital-adequacy (BIS) ratio by roughly 0.34 percentage point, freeing capital that can be redeployed into new lending or returned to shareholders. Analysts see the change strengthening the banks' international competitiveness and risk-management standing, and markets have flagged wider dividend-payout capacity as a near-term positive. The staged floor means benefits accrue gradually rather than all at once, but the direction of travel is clearly capital-accretive for the group.

items.title_zh: 震盪行情下，定期定額 ETF 策略再受青睞
items.title_en: Volatility revives the case for regular ETF investing
items.summary_zh: 面對盤勢劇烈波動，財管端引導客戶回歸紀律化的定期定額布局，透過 0050、0056、00878 及較新的 00981A 等台股 ETF 分批進場。訴求在於自動化定期投資可在回檔中平滑成本、長期累積配息，降低追高殺低的衝動。2026 年 7 月最新比較顯示，市值型、高股息與因子型產品在殖利率與總報酬各有差異，投資人應依「收益 vs 成長」目標選擇合適標的，並衡量自身風險承受度。
items.summary_en: Amid the sharp market swings, wealth desks are pointing clients back to disciplined, dollar-cost-averaging strategies through broad Taiwan ETFs such as 0050, 0056, 00878 and the newer 00981A. The pitch is that automated periodic investing smooths entry prices through drawdowns and captures dividend yield over time, reducing the temptation to time a falling market. Comparative July 2026 tables highlight differing yields and total-return profiles across market-cap, high-dividend and factor products, underscoring the need to match each vehicle to an investor's income-versus-growth goals.

items.title_zh: 海外配置成台灣超高資產族群標配
items.title_en: Offshore allocation now standard for Taiwan's ultra-rich
items.summary_zh: 中國信託攜手 BCG 的超高資產客群研究指出，境外配置已近乎標準配備：十億級以上客群 86% 持有海外資產，逾半數（52%）已將至少 20% 資產配置海外。整體高資產客群 2025 至 2029 年年複合成長率約 10%，十億超高資產層級最快、達約 11%。對私銀與信託業者而言，數據顯示在本地市場劇烈震盪之際，跨境分散、結構型商品與傳承規劃需求將持續升溫，財管商機可期。
items.summary_en: A CTBC × BCG study of Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth segment finds overseas allocation has become near-default: 86% of billion-dollar-plus clients hold offshore assets and over half (52%) already place at least 20% of wealth abroad. The high-net-worth pool is projected to grow at roughly 10% a year through 2029, with the billion-dollar tier fastest at about 11%. For private-banking and trust providers, the data points to sustained demand for cross-border diversification, structured products and succession planning as domestic markets whipsaw.
